dedupe_keys.name: wind tunnel testing of flexible advanced aeroelastic models of bridge cables

description: CSTB and collaborating researchers publish FLAMBeRG wind-tunnel experiments on flexible bridge cables at the Jules Verne facility in Nantes. Zenodo supplies separate smooth-cable and iced-cable archives free under CC BY 4.0. Models have a 110-millimetre diameter and a diameter-to-length ratio of 1:40. Tests vary pretension for five- and ten-hertz first modes and use zero- and fifteen-degree yaw. These observations can calibrate wind-induced vibration components in bridge simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this experimental family. The ERIES portal and a later Zenodo pointer describe the same campaign, so they are consolidated here. Coverage is controlled scaled cables, with some iced configurations limited by coupled motion and damping. Internal formats and uncertainty remain unverified. No archive was downloaded or aeroelastic response reproduced.
